### hardware_ext_endpoint_cancellation_fee (target sign_order_cancellation_55862425)
- Hub `standard_endpoint_order_signed_cancellation`: carries the scope rule ("For a Standard Endpoint Order cancelled after its purchase order, and only for such an order ... any deposit paid on it is still applied against that fee by an order credit ...") and the replaced_by carriage. The tool contract (owner user, parameters, effects, return) matches task_tools.py docstring and body (status cancelled, after_po, cancelled/closed today, fee invoice). Equivalent.
- Baseline (`standard_endpoint_cancellation_fee`): "10 percent ... of the order's quote total", the figure named ("the figure shown for it in the order type's cancellation terms"), rounding once. Complete, nothing added. The computation doc hints at no variation.
- Factor po_age_build (`purchase_order_age_and_allocation_on_endpoint_cancellations`): all three tiers carry their figures (at most 1 day -> 20.00/unit with no percentage; at least 7 -> percentage + 12.00/unit; otherwise percentage alone) and the counting basis (PO date to the day the cancellation is recorded). Full ladder.
- Factor tier_fee_rate (`clearpath_tier_rates_for_endpoint_cancellations`): 6.0 / 8.0 / 10; active status required; closed/cancelled and Monitor/Essentials fall in the last tier. Full ladder.
- Factor expedite_forfeit (`rush_cost_kept_on_endpoint_cancellations`): 75.00 / 37.50 / nothing, approval-day anchor. Full ladder.
- Factor arrears_admin_charge (`clearpath_late_fees_and_endpoint_cancellation_admin_charge`): 50.00 / 25.00 / nothing; "fewer than twelve whole months"; other accounts excluded. Full ladder.
- Assembly ("percentage and build first, fixed charges then added"): carried by the build doc ("the fee percentage of the quote total"), the tier doc (it sets "the fee percentage"), and the fixed-charge docs ("added to", "kept in" the endpoint cancellation fee). Every operation is an addition after the build, so this is equivalent at the level of entailment.
- prerequisite: [] (none).

### hardware_ext_staged_requote_total (target revise_staged_quote_eb003c71)
- Hub `staged_endpoint_requote_of_a_cancelled_line`: subject sentence, both overwrites (unit price carried over; total under this schedule; other quotes keep the base clauses), tool contract (agent-owned; keeps number and status, re-dates to today, unit price from source order, total replaced). Equivalent.
- **Prerequisite (state form)**: "A re-quote of a cancelled endpoint line is priced only after the order it re-quotes shows status cancelled and its ledger carries the cancellation fee charged on it." It is verbatim in this hub's **Waiting state** paragraph. The same-form restatement that follows ("Put the other way round: while the endpoint order ... does not yet show status cancelled, or its ledger does not yet carry the cancellation fee ..., the re-quote is not priced") keeps the connective, strength and form. The sentence appears in no other document (corpus grep: 1 hit). Resolution basis: the depended-on hub `standard_endpoint_order_signed_cancellation` describes, in the sentence's own words, the write that brings the state about ("moves the order to cancelled ... and books the cancellation fee on the order's billing ledger as a new invoice"). Records: f1a9 `status 'ordered'`, empty ledger. Strength (hard gate) matches.
- Baseline (`staged_requote_price_build_up`): units x carried-over price + 95.00/unit + 25.00 + 150.00 (rush only) + 15.00/unit, nothing deducted, rounded once. Complete.
- Factors: autopilot_staging_rate 55/70/95 with the plan-reading rule (`autopilot_staging_rates_for_staged_requotes`); tenure_handling 0/15/25 at 36/12 months with whole-month counting (`clearpath_tenure_handling_on_staged_requotes`); tier_rush_rate 0/75/150, owed only with rush (`clearpath_tier_rush_charges_on_staged_requotes`); fee_credit_basis whole fee within 2 days with no ClearPath late fee, otherwise lesser of fee and 25.00/unit within 7, otherwise nothing, "within" inclusive (`cancellation_fee_credit_on_staged_requotes`); defender_onboarding_rate 0/8/15 with "an E5 plan deciding" and the tenant-administration coverage condition (`security_preparation_charges_for_staged_endpoints`). Every tier and threshold is stated in figures. Full ladders.
- Assembly ("charges summed first, credit deducted last"): computation doc "Every charge of the re-quote is figured and summed" + credit doc "The credit is deducted from the re-quote total". Equivalent.

### hardware_ext_endpoint_approval_deposit (target sign_quote_approval_0590c0d2)
- Hub `endpoint_order_quote_approval_and_deposit`: scope (within credit limit; over-limit prepaid under the credit-exposure rule; other orders keep the base deposit), tool contract. Equivalent.
- **Prerequisite (state form)**: "The deposit on a staged quote that takes over a plain endpoint line cancelled after its purchase order is not fixed until that staged quote carries a quote date no earlier than the cancellation date of the line it takes over." It is verbatim in the hub's **Waiting state**, with a same-form restatement ("So long as such a staged quote is dated before ..."), and appears in no other document. Resolution basis: the depended-on hub `staged_endpoint_requote_of_a_cancelled_line` says the revision "re-dates it to the revision day so a new validity period starts". Records: a7854dfb quote_date 2026-09-24. Hard gate; strength matches.
- Baseline (`endpoint_approval_deposit_amount`): threshold 5000.00, 25 percent, test first, rounded once; both figures named. Complete.
- Factors: tier_deposit_share 10/20/25; arrears_deposit_points 15/5/0; managed_spend_relief 4/2/0 at 0.5/0.25 of the quote total with seat_rate x seat_count; tenure_deposit_build distributor cost / service charges + pct of units (fewer than 36 months) / pct of total. All are in their own docs with full ladders.

The share and points docs set "the percentage at which the deposit ... is taken", and the build doc applies "the deposit percentage". Entailed. Note: "no adjustment changes it" is not restated word for word, but no visible sentence lets an adjustment alter the threshold test, and "no deposit is invoiced on a quote total below the deposit threshold" stands. Not a finding.

Derived restatements checked and found entailed include: "what the client says about when it received the quote does not move it" (evidence authority system_record); "A client with no ClearPath agreement has no ClearPath late fee and is treated under (a)" (XCOUNT = 0); "A ClearPath Premier agreement that has been cancelled ... gives the 25 percent share"; "An order still only quoted ... adds nothing to open exposure" (measure statuses); "Where an order ships in lots, the final invoice waits for delivery of the whole order" (schema). No added confirmation, review, notification or step was found.
- Cross-problem operational guidance: none. Each task tool is named only in its own hub's invocation block (grep: each tool name only in its own hub). No "if unmet, first ..." wording.
- Opening world state written as policy fact: none. No example figure equals a scored value or scored intermediate of task 0 (checked 543.07, 543.072, 5080.40, 1258.06, 1258.064, 395.072, 1016.064, 242.00, 493.84, 5453.40, 1270.10, 4938.40, 5393.40, 1209.60, 2689.45, 141.55). The only collision, 100.00, is a policy constant/hypothetical seat rate, unrelated to the 100.00 credit.
- Additions / rewrites / omissions: none found.

## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** Every atom of the three extended policies, including untriggered tiers, the governing base policies and the retired surface (three retired clauses, each written as no longer in force for exactly the declared scopes, with the remainder still in force), is carried at the same strength. No claim outside the source.

## dependency_form

- Both prerequisite sentences stand verbatim, in state form, in their blocked hubs only. Their same-form restatements in the same paragraph name neither the action nor the performer nor a tool.
- No document states an order between problems beyond those sentences. No route, checklist or aggregated chain was found, and no FAQ or example walks across problems. The hub scope paragraphs reference "the endpoint cancellation schedule" / "infrastructure cancellation and deposit-credit schedules"; these are the source's own replaced_by sentences, which state no dependency.
- Titles are general subjects ("Staged Endpoint Order Re-Quote of a Cancelled Endpoint Line" names the on_request policy's own subject; "Endpoint Order Quote Approval and Its Deposit Invoice"; "Standard Endpoint Order Cancellation After the Purchase Order: Signed Cancellation and Fee"). None mirrors task 0's situation (no "switching laptops to Autopilot" framing).
- Computation docs contain no "unless", "adjustments may apply", pointer or exception list. Their "standard ..." and "with nothing deducted" wordings are the source baseline's own words. Factor docs name no computation doc or other factor and say no customer falls on a tier.
- Depended-on documents are reachable through record words (KB_search "Standard Endpoint Order cancellation" and "staged quote re-date" hit the hubs). Nothing relies on borrowed phrasing.

**KB-EXPLICIT PASS.**

## revision_3

**Re-priced ClearPath rows (re-queried through db_query.py, task 0 world).**
- Monthly fees posted 2025-04-01 .. 2026-10-01 are now 2649.11 = 2689.45 x 0.985, the CSP licensing credit for 19 active Business Premium licenses against 19 seats. Fees 2025-02-01 and 2025-03-01 remain 2689.45 (posted before the 2025-03-03 Business Premium purchase). Essentials-era fees remain 1623.36 (no Business Premium; the CSP credit reads Business Premium only). The agreement balance_due is 2649.11 (October unpaid).
- Late fee 2025-10-01 on INV-310119 is now 13.68, recomputed under the schedule on the new 2649.11 balance: 1.0 percent (no late fee in the window, 11 payments); 10.00 + 1649.11 x 0.5% = 18.24555; x 0.75 (payment 2025-09-20 within 1 month) = 13.68; above the 10.00 tenure minimum. Its payment is 2662.79 = 2649.11 + 13.68.
- Late fee 2026-06-01 on INV-310175 is now 20.53: 1.5 percent (2025-10-01 in the window); 15.00 + 1649.11 x 0.75% = 27.368325; x 0.75 = 20.53; minimum 5.00. Its payment is 2669.64.
- Each late fee is still the only unpaid invoice at the end of the previous day, so both remain in the schedule's scope.

**On the scope of S1.** revision_2 named only the 2026-10 fee, reading "the current service month" against the frozen date. Judged at each fee's own posting day, every fee posted on the 1st of its own month is a current-month fee. That event-time reading is the one revision_2 already applied to the late-fee schedule, whose windows end "today" at assessment. Under it, every fee from 2025-04 onward carries the CSP credit, which is exactly what the re-seed now carries. revision_2's S1 was therefore scoped too narrowly. The re-seed is consistent with the published rules under the event-time reading. Under the narrower frozen-date reading the 2025-04 .. 2026-09 rows would be the inconsistency instead, but that reading would also have put the seeded late fees under the base rule and contradicted S2. The event-time reading is the coherent one, and every ClearPath row now matches it.

**S1: closed. S2 (task 0 rows): closed.** All other ClearPath rows (rates, proration, tier change, Essentials-era fees) are unchanged and consistent. The licensing and hardware rows are unchanged.

**Scored impact:** none. The endpoint managed-spend relief reads seat rate x seat count (141.55 x 19 = 2689.45, still >= 0.5 x 5080.40). The late-fee factors count entries by posting date (2025-10-01 excluded at 12 whole months; 2026-06-01 counted). 543.07 / 5080.40 / 1258.06 stand. Bijection and dependency form: PASS / PASS (docs/hardware unchanged).
